verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a recruiting SaaS platform, so recurring scheduled jobs or workflows are a fair axis. The evidence shows only event-driven webhooks, generic automation claims, bulk outreach campaigns and onboarding milestones. None of these documents a user-configurable recurring schedule, and one-off or event-triggered automation is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
